title: Senior FPGA Developer
description:
About the Company: Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

About the Role: We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.

Responsibilities:

  • The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools.
  • This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.

Qualifications:

  • BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps SerDes/transceiver-based FPGA designs.

Required Skills:

  • Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL required.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.

Preferred Skills: Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

O que precisamos que você tenha

  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Domínio de CPC, IFRS e normas do CFC
  • Conhecimento avançado em consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras
  • Experiência real conduzindo projetos, não só participando deles
  • Excel e Word em nível avançado
  • Espanhol fluente. Requisito obrigatório, você vai conduzir reuniões e projetos nesse idioma;

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala
  • Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto

title: Data Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We're currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that's running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients' key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You'll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You'll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients, working with them to identify and answer key questions. You'll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: People Partner (Brazil)
description:
ABOUT US

DigiPlus Interactive Corp., a leader in digital entertainment in the Philippines, is now in Brazil! We have officially launched DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda. and are fully licensed to deliver innovative experiences in the Brazilian iGaming market. We are bringing the success of renowned platforms such as BingoPlus and ArenaPlus to create new opportunities and outstanding experiences for Brazilian players. Join us and be part of this journey of innovation and entertainment!

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly capable, hands-on People Partner to own the day-to-day execution of Human Resources for our Brazil operations. HR strategy, policy frameworks, and organizational direction are set in partnership with our Asia-based leadership team; this role is responsible for adapting and implementing those frameworks locally, and for providing the on-the-ground regulatory, cultural, and market insight that shapes those decisions for Brazil.

The right person combines strong hands-on HR operational expertise with the judgment to flag what needs adapting for the Brazilian context, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multicultural, rapidly scaling environment with close, regular collaboration with supervision based in Asia.

Payroll and employee admissions/dismissals (admissões e demissões) are supported by external consultants; this role is responsible for coordinating closely with those consultants to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely execution.

The role works closely with regional leadership, department heads, Finance, Admin, and external vendors to execute HR operations and deliver a strong employee experience across the organization.

Advanced English communication is required for collaboration with international stakeholders and global teams.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience personally executing HR operations
  • Solid understanding of Brazil labor law, HR compliance, and employee relations
  • Direct, personal experience executing:
  • Employee lifecycle management (recruitment through offboarding)
  • Attendance and leave administration
  • Payroll coordination with external payroll consultants, and related HR compliance
  • Coordination with external consultants on employee admissions and dismissals (admissões e demissões)
  • Performance management processes
  • HR policies, SOPs, and internal governance — implementing and localizing frameworks set by leadership
  • Talent Acquisition and recruitment operations
  • HRIS and employee data management systems
  • Onboarding and offboarding processes
  • Employee relations and workplace issue handling
  • Compensation and benefits coordination
  • HR reporting and workforce documentation
  • Ability to translate global/regional HR strategy into locally compliant, practical execution
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including upward communication of local insights to Asia-based leadership
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict management capabilities
  • Ability to work independently and drive execution end-to-end with minimal supervision
  • 5+ years of hands-on, operational HR experience (generalist or specialist), building or improving HR processes and workflows
  • Professional English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in: iGaming, Technology, Internet, Startups, and Multinational environments
  • Experience supporting 0–1 office or organizational setup
  • Experience handling expatriate employees and cross-border HR coordination
  • Familiarity with Brazil payroll vendors, labor processes, and HR outsourcing providers
  • Experience adapting global HR frameworks and policies to local market requirements
  • Experience driving employee engagement and company culture initiatives on the ground
  • Experience supporting employer branding and recruitment marketing activities
  • Knowledge of HR analytics and workforce reporting

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute day-to-day HR operations for the Brazil office
  • Implement and localize HR policies, SOPs, and internal processes set in partnership with Asia-based leadership, ensuring full compliance with Brazil labor law
  • Provide local regulatory, cultural, and market insight to inform HR strategy and policy decisions made with Asia
  • Execute the full employee lifecycle including:
  • Recruitment
  • Onboarding (coordinating admissions with external consultants)
  • Probation management
  • Employee movement
  • Performance reviews
  • Offboarding (coordinating dismissals with external consultants)
  • Support Talent Acquisition activities and workforce planning in partnership with business leaders
  • Manage attendance, leave management, employee records, and HR documentation
  • Coordinate with external consultants on payroll and on employee admissions and dismissals (admissões e demissões), ensuring accuracy and compliance
  • Coordinate benefits administration and HR vendor management together with Finance and external providers
  • Handle employee relations matters and support conflict resolution when necessary
  • Execute performance management and employee engagement initiatives locally
  • Partner with department heads on local workforce and manpower needs, feeding input back to Asia for organizational development decisions
  • Maintain and keep accurate Lark/HRIS systems and employee data
  • Support local company culture and internal communication initiatives, aligned with global direction
  • Prepare HR reports, operational updates, and workforce summaries for Asia-based leadership
  • Support office setup, HR administration, and cross-functional operational coordination when required
  • Flag and recommend opportunities to improve local HR efficiency and employee experience, for review with leadership

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

Experiência no segmento de nutrição animal, alimentos, agronegócio ou indústria de transformação.

Conhecimento em gestão de custos industriais e controle orçamentário.

CNH B e disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais

PPR (Programa de participação de resultados);

Seguro de Vida;

Wellhub (Gympass);

Parcerias Educacionais com Faculdades e Escolas de Ensino/Universidade COCARI entre outros benefícios.

Informações

  • Supervisionar e coordenar as atividades da área de Produção da Fábrica de Ração, garantindo a execução eficiente dos processos, o alcance das metas operacionais e a qualidade dos produtos, por meio da liderança, orientação e desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Liderar, acompanhar e avaliar o desempenho dos colaboradores, realizando feedbacks periódicos e promovendo ações de desenvolvimento que contribuam para o aprimoramento das competências e dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.

  • Strong experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM), ideally within large-scale transformation programs.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!"

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Governança de Inteligência Artificial para apoiar a implementação e evolução do framework corporativo de Governança de IA. O profissional ideal deve ser capaz de promover o uso responsável, ético, seguro, transparente e aderente às exigências regulatórias do setor bancário.

Principais atribuições:

  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução do framework corporativo de Governança de IA.
  • Manter o inventário de ativos de IA, incluindo modelos, agentes, prompts, bases de conhecimento e provedores externos.
  • Elaborar e manter taxonomias, políticas, padrões, procedimentos, indicadores e trilhas de auditoria.
  • Garantir requisitos de transparência, rastreabilidade, explicabilidade e documentação.
  • Apoiar a disseminação da cultura de IA responsável.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em Governança de IA, incluindo inventário de ativos, gestão do ciclo de vida de modelos, classificação de riscos, auditoria, rastreabilidade e accountability.
  • Profundos conhecimento de IA, incluindo LLMs, RAG, IA agêntica, embeddings, bancos vetoriais, grounding e guardrails.
  • Conhecimento dos principais frameworks e normas de mercado, como NIST AI RMF, EU IA ACT, ISO/IEC 42001 e LGPD.
  • Conhecimento em Governança de Dados, incluindo DAMA-DMBOK, gestão de metadados, qualidade de dados, linhagem, Data Stewardship, glossários de negócio, taxonomias, ontologias e gestão semântica.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade, avaliação e monitoramento de soluções de IA, incluindo evals, harnesses de testes, explicabilidade (XAI), Model Cards e Datasheets for Datasets.
  • Capacidade de elaborar políticas, padrões, relatórios e documentação técnica.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Governança de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Gestão de Riscos ou Segurança da Informação.
  • Conhecimento em MLOps, LLMOps, arquiteturas multiagentes, Model Context Protocol (MCP) e agent skills.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo, metadados, observabilidade e governança de IA.
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA, incluindo riscos relacionados a prompt injection, data leakage e jailbreak.
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Idioma Inglês avançado para eventuais conversações com fornecedores de solução.

title: Entrevistador(a) de Campo
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!

Sobre a função

O(A) Entrevistador(a) é responsável pela coleta de informações em domicílios participantes dos painéis da empresa, contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade dos dados utilizados por nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, organizados e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal para atuar em atividades de campo, seguindo padrões de qualidade e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, treinamentos e orientações conduzidos pela supervisão e coordenação.
  • Ler, compreender e aplicar corretamente os manuais, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos relacionados à coleta de dados.
  • Manter todos os materiais e equipamentos de trabalho atualizados e em boas condições de uso (dispositivo Android, formulários, identificadores de amostras, roteiros de visita e materiais de apoio).
  • Recrutar e integrar novos domicílios ao Painel de Consumidores, quando necessário.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de domicílios sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo o correto acompanhamento dos participantes e mantendo um relacionamento cordial e colaborativo com as famílias.
  • Realizar visitas domiciliares periódicas (semanais ou quinzenais), conforme roteiro definido, cumprindo rigorosamente os procedimentos de coleta.
  • Entregar/enviar comunicados e materiais informativos aos participantes do painel.
  • Acompanhar e auxiliar solicitações de resgate de recompensas de acordo com a pontuação acumulada pelos participantes.
  • Retornar aos domicílios sempre que necessário para corrigir informações, complementar dados ou esclarecer dúvidas.
  • Atualizar continuamente o cadastro dos moradores, registrando alterações como entrada ou saída de residentes, nascimento de crianças e outras mudanças relevantes.
  • Manter atualizadas as informações sobre animais de estimação e bens de consumo do domicílio.
  • Realizar a atualização anual do censo domiciliar, garantindo a consistência e integridade das informações cadastradas.
  • Transmitir os dados coletados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Executar pesquisas especiais e projetos específicos quando designado pela empresa.

Perfil desejado

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas.
  • Cordialidade, empatia e postura profissional durante as visitas domiciliares.
  • Capacidade de despertar confiança e engajamento dos participantes da pesquisa.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes na coleta e registro das informações.
  • Comprometimento com prazos, qualidade dos dados e cumprimento de procedimentos.
  • Voz clara, audível e boa dicção.
  • Responsabilidade na utilização da identificação da empresa, mantendo o crachá visível durante toda a execução das entrevistas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com atendimento ao público, pesquisas de campo ou visitas domiciliares.
  • Familiaridade com o uso de dispositivos móveis e aplicativos de coleta de dados.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma, seguindo rotas e cronogramas definidos.

Numerator is a data company transforming how consumers and markets are understood. Powered by advanced technology and proprietary, zero-party purchase and survey data from more than one million households, Numerator provides visibility into consumer behavior and attitudes across consumer goods, retail, restaurants, tech and media, management consulting, institutional investors, and the public sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Numerator drives decisions at the world's largest and fastest-growing companies in more than 50 countries.

title: Direct Response Ads | Video Editor
description:
About Hydroh:

We're one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.

Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.

We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we're talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.

Compensation & Perks:

  • Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
  • Fully Remote
  • Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
  • Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
  • Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
  • Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
  • Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
  • Clear communicator and proactive with timelines

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
  • Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
  • Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
  • Editing for long-form VSLs

What you'll be doing:

  • Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok
  • Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
  • Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
  • Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
  • Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed

We're looking to hire immediately — so if you're an editor who gets performance, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

Aqui você vai encontrar muito mais do que excelentes benefícios em uma referência no mercado financeiro. Você fará parte de uma instituição que respira a cultura ESG, preza por um ambiente harmonioso, com pessoas acessíveis, e promove diversas iniciativas para o desenvolvimento de carreiras.

description:
SOBRE A VAGA

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.

Produzir conteúdo para marcas parceiras devidamente licenciadas pela SPA/MF (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas).

Evoluir dentro da trilha de progressão da Doppa conforme volume e qualidade dos vídeos.

PONTOS DE ATENÇÃO

É imprescindível ter mais do que 18 anos para se candidatar.

Trabalhamos exclusivamente com operadores licenciados pela SPA/MF e seguimos rigorosamente a Portaria SPA/MF no 1.231/2024, que regula a publicidade do setor de apostas no Brasil.

Toda comunicação produzida na Doppa segue diretrizes claras de transparência: identificação de parceria, exibição de licença e proibição de qualquer promessa de retorno garantido.

Não trabalhamos com discurso de "ganhar dinheiro fácil". Trabalhamos com formação real de criadores dentro de um setor regulamentado, sério e em expansão.

Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Operador de Manufatura A - [Exclusiva PCD] Curitiba
description:
Compartilhe suas ideias. Transforme o mundo para melhor.

Curitiba - PR

No Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!

Atuando de maneira dinâmica, ágil e focada na satisfação do consumidor, as equipes de Manufatura contribuem para garantir que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação em produtos e serviços.

O que você vai fazer:

Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.

Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:

title: EHS Supervisor (environmental)
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company's business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision's smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world's largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure project activities follow local, state, and federal environmental regulations and company EHS standards.
  • Identify potential environmental hazards before and during project execution.
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Conduct routine field checks to evaluate air, water, noise, waste management practices and other EHS topics.
  • Oversee the segregation, storage, transport, and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented, focused on environmental events.
  • Promote environmental awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and compliance reports for management, customer and regulatory agencies (when applicable).
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or technical qualification in Environmental, Engineering, or related fields
  • Proven experience in Environmental management within wind farm, construction, or energy projects
  • Strong knowledge of environmental management systems, effective communication, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (for multinational environments)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Accounting Lead
description:
Position Purpose

To lead and oversee the Accounting, Fiscal (Tax), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury functions. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational and reporting excellence across all financial processes. This leader must act as a strategic business consultant, ensuring strategic alignment and supporting decision-making across the entire company.

The owner of the role is also responsible for the fulfillment of both the Grünenthal and local Codes of Conduct in the activities organized by him/her, as well as in those in which he/she participates.

Key Responsibilities

Fiscal, Tax Governance, and Credits

  • Lead the tax credit strategy, actively seeking efficient and additional tax optimization opportunities, in full compliance and alignment with corporate governance.
  • Lead the entire implementation and update of the Brazilian Tax Reform, analyzing its impacts and ensuring business continuity and compliance.
  • Manage the relationship and deliverables of external consultants (Tax).
  • Lead compliance processes with external audit firms (Big Four).
  • Ensure full operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.
  • Search for efficient tax strategies, according to corporate guidance.

Accounting, Audit, and Treasury Management

  • Oversee all Accounting (IFRS/CPCs/German GAAP), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury routines.
  • Lead and coordinate all external (Big Four) and internal audit processes, ensuring deadlines are met and recommendations are correctly implemented.
  • Ensure the accuracy and correct recording of all financial transactions.
  • Lead initiatives to optimize working capital.
  • Lead Continuous Process Improvement initiatives.
  • Manage the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and execution of activities performed by the Shared Service Center (SSC) in Lisbon, Portugal.
  • Coordinate accounting, tax, and treasury projects and ensure their implementation according to corporate requirements.
  • Identify and establish effective procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure proper reporting to governmental entities in accordance with local legislation.
  • Manage the Other Operating Results Budget.
  • Prepare and monitor Cash Flow.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.

Capability Requirements

Mandatory

  • University Degree in Accounting.
  • Active CRC (CPA equivalent).
  • Solid experience in Accounting and Tax Management.
  • Experience working with a Shared Service Center (SSC).
  • Experience reviewing Financial Statements.
  • Experience reviewing ECD and ECF filings.

Desirable

  • MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Finance or Controlling.
  • Previous experience with auditing firms (Big Four).

Interfaces

Internal

  • All business areas, with particular interaction with:
  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Supply Chain
  • Legal
  • Finance Teams

External

  • Big Four Auditors
  • Tax and Accounting Consultants
  • Banks
  • Tax Authorities (RFB and others)
  • Fiscal and Accounting BPO Providers

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior (Impostos Diretos e Indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary.
  • Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others.
  • Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information.
  • Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements.
  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.
  • Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients.
  • Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.
  • Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

  • Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets.
  • All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

title: ANALISTA departamento pessoal
description:
O Analista de Departamento Pessoal será responsável pela execução, conferência e acompanhamento das rotinas trabalhistas e previdenciárias dos clientes da Contabilidade Evoluir, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, a correta aplicação da legislação e a qualidade das informações processadas.

Principais atividades:

Realizar o processamento, a conferência e o fechamento da folha de pagamento dos clientes;

Calcular e conferir salários, pró-labore, adicionais, horas extras, descontos, benefícios e encargos trabalhistas e previdenciários;

Executar processos de admissão, incluindo análise de documentos, registro de empregados e envio das informações aos sistemas oficiais;

Realizar desligamentos, calcular verbas rescisórias, emitir documentos e acompanhar os prazos legais;

Controlar e calcular férias individuais e coletivas, observando os períodos aquisitivos, concessivos e os prazos legais;

Efetuar o fechamento e a conferência do ponto eletrônico, banco de horas, faltas, atrasos e jornadas de trabalho;

Apurar e conferir INSS, FGTS, IRRF e demais encargos incidentes sobre a folha de pagamento;

Transmitir, conferir e acompanhar as obrigações trabalhistas e previdenciárias aplicáveis, incluindo eSocial, DCTFWeb, FGTS Digital e demais declarações exigidas;

Emitir guias, relatórios, recibos e documentos relacionados às rotinas do Departamento Pessoal;

Acompanhar afastamentos, licenças e atestados médicos, prestando orientação sobre os procedimentos perante o INSS;

Interpretar e aplicar Convenções e Acordos Coletivos de Trabalho, garantindo o correto enquadramento sindical e o cumprimento das cláusulas aplicáveis;

Realizar o controle e a conferência de benefícios, como vale-transporte, vale-alimentação, assistência médica e seguro de vida, conforme a realidade de cada cliente;

Prestar atendimento consultivo aos clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando sobre legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e procedimentos do Departamento Pessoal;

Identificar inconsistências, riscos trabalhistas e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos dos clientes;

REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS

title: Buyer
description:
About the Company

Tenneco is one of the world's leading designers, manufacturers, and marketers of automotive products for original equipment and aftermarket customers, with approximately 65,000 team members working across more than 200 locations worldwide.

Through our four business groups — DRiV, Performance Solutions, Clean Air, and Powertrain — Tenneco is driving advancements in global mobility by delivering technology solutions to diverse markets, including light vehicles, commercial trucks, off-highway, industrial, motorsports, and aftermarket applications.

This position will be part of Tenneco's Ride Performance business, within the Shock Absorbers division, based in Mogi Mirim, São Paulo, Brazil.

About the Role

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing and developing productive materials for new product development projects across multiple commodities, including steel, stamped components, sintered parts, tubes, machined components, plastics, bearings, fasteners, rubber, chemicals, and others.

This role will be responsible for obtaining quotations and supporting the development and cost evaluation of new products, working closely with Quality and Engineering teams to develop new suppliers and products according to technical specifications. The position will also be responsible for negotiating commercial conditions and implementing commercial agreements and contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Request and analyze quotations in accordance with company policies from qualified and/or potential suppliers, ensuring compliance with technical specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and project timelines.
  • Obtain quotations for productive materials to support the preparation and evaluation of the Bill of Materials (BOM) for new products.
  • Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery conditions, and other commercial requirements with suppliers.
  • Conduct technical and commercial analysis of supplier proposals in collaboration with Quality and Product Engineering teams.
  • Lead the sourcing process and obtain the required internal approvals.
  • Select and nominate suppliers and coordinate the issuance and execution of commercial contracts.
  • Request and follow up on required PPAP documentation.
  • Follow up, when applicable, on quality testing, sample deliveries, and validation activities to ensure that materials and/or finished products meet project specifications and deadlines.
  • Analyze technical and financial proposals for new and existing components to achieve competitive sourcing results.
  • Negotiate competitive payment terms to optimize the company's working capital.
  • Follow up on the issuance of Purchase Orders and, when applicable, monitor the process through material delivery to ensure internal stakeholders' requirements are met.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams throughout the new product development and sourcing process.
  • Support cost competitiveness and supplier development initiatives aligned with business and project objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Materials Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to Advanced English.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with SAP.
  • Knowledge of sourcing processes for new products and supplier development.
  • Experience in the automotive industry and/or with productive materials and commodities is highly desirable.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects and priorities.

Required Skills

  • Negotiation skills.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Communication skills.
  • Problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in the automotive industry.
  • Knowledge of productive materials and commodities.

Salary Range & Compensation Package

We want you to feel welcomed, challenged, and inspired. That is why we have carefully designed a comprehensive benefits package focused on supporting your health and well-being, professional and personal growth, and integration into a positive and collaborative work environment.

title: Vendedora (E-commerce)
description:
VAGA: Vendedora – Dalla Store

Presencial — São Caetano do Sul

Remuneração: Fixo + comissão sobre vendas

Horário sugerido: Segunda a Sexta, das 9:00 às 18:00 horas

Vaga Efetiva (com experiência de 3 meses)

SOBRE A DALLA STORE

A Dalla não contrata pra preencher cadeira.

Somos um e-commerce de moda feminina em crescimento acelerado, com o propósito de facilitar a rotina das mulheres através de conjuntos práticos, confortáveis e estilosos. Estamos construindo a maior marca brasileira de conjuntos femininos até 2035 — e o time precisa crescer nesse ritmo.

Essa vaga não é de "responder mensagem no automático e esperar a venda acontecer". É de assumir o relacionamento com a cliente do primeiro contato até a compra — e fazer ela voltar.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Você vai garantir que cada conversa com a cliente seja conduzida com clareza, agilidade e poder de conversão — do primeiro "oi" até o fechamento.

O jogo é claro: se a cliente compra, recomenda e volta a comprar... você venceu. E vai ser recompensada por isso.

  • Atender e conduzir vendas via Instagram e WhatsApp, do primeiro contato ao fechamento
  • Identificar a necessidade da cliente e indicar o produto certo — sem empurrar peça errada só pra bater meta
  • Fazer follow-up ativo de carrinhos abandonados e clientes em negociação, sem deixar lead esfriar
  • Identificar objeções recorrentes e ajustar a abordagem antes que virem perda de venda
  • Bater metas diárias e semanais de conversão e ticket médio
  • Garantir que a cliente saia satisfeita e pronta para comprar de novo

O Que Esperamos de Você

  • Comunicação escrita ágil, persuasiva e sem erro de português — você escreve rápido e bem o dia inteiro
  • Resiliência de verdade — muita conversa não vira venda, e isso não pode te abalar nem mudar seu padrão de atendimento
  • Organização para conduzir várias conversas em paralelo sem perder o timing de cada uma
  • Leitura de cenário e senso de dono — perceber quando uma cliente está quase fechando e agir, sem esperar comando
  • Capacidade de receber feedback e cobrança como parte do jogo — aqui ninguém vai adivinhar o que você sente, vamos te dizer na cara o que precisa melhorar

Diferenciais (Vai Te Destacar Muito)

  • Já vendeu algo — online, loja física ou redes sociais — e tem exemplo concreto de resultado, não só "tenho jeito com pessoas"
  • Experiência em atendimento de alto volume via Instagram/WhatsApp
  • Vivência com moda, e-commerce ou vendas consultivas
  • Familiaridade com métricas básicas de venda (conversão, ticket médio, follow-up)

Não É Pra Você Se:

  • Precisa que expliquem o que dizer em cada nova objeção da cliente
  • Acha que vendas é só "responder o que perguntam" e esperar a cliente decidir sozinha
  • Não lida bem com "não" — e desanima ou perde ritmo depois de uma sequência de recusas
  • Busca ambiente estável, sem meta e sem pressão por resultado
  • Não se sente confortável sendo cobrada por número, todos os dias

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Comissão real sobre performance, sem teto
  • Treinamento sobre produto, abordagem e cultura Dalla
  • Ambiente de ritmo acelerado, com metas claras e feedback constante
  • Possibilidade real de evolução para liderança de vendas conforme a Dalla escala
  • A chance de sentir na pele o impacto direto do seu trabalho no resultado da empresa

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Analítico PL
description:
Conheça a Blanver:

A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 42 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. A experiência e atuação no desenvolvimento, fabricação e comercialização de medicamentos e insumos farmacêuticos ativos (IFAs) tornou a Blanver especialista nos segmentos de HIV, Hepatite e Osteoporose, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade, atendendo pacientes no Brasil por meio de parcerias com o Ministério da Saúde e laboratórios oficiais. Além disso, também estamos presentes nos segmentos de Oncologia, Doenças Raras e Hematologia, por meio de parcerias estratégias com grandes parceiros internacionais.

As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.

Essas serão algumas das atividades do dia-a-dia como Analista de Desenvolvimento Analitico Pleno.

  • Realizar desenvolvimento de metodologias analíticas por LCMS, HPLC, PSD, UV-VIS, DSC e teste físico-químicos.
  • Realizar estudos e testes de pré-formulação para atender as solicitações da área de Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos analistas juniores durante a execução de análises, esclarecimento de dúvidas relacionadas a documentos e relatórios, além de auxiliar na conferência de documentação.
  • Realizar análises de risco para embasar alterações em processos industriais, com foco na melhoria contínua e no aumento da eficiência operacional.
  • Realizar a adequação pós-registro dos produtos, conforme exigência da Anvisa ou órgãos externos.
  • Elaboração, revisão, padronização e controle de documentos técnicos, como métodos analíticos, relatórios de desenvolvimento, validação e transferências analíticas, assegurando a conformidade com as diretrizes regulatórias e os padrões internos de qualidade.

title: Técnico ambiental
description:

  • Conhecimento em legislação e processos ambientais.
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office.

  • Conhecimento ou experiência em inventários florestais e levantamentos de vegetação nativa;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal e atuação colaborativa com diferentes áreas;

  • Identificação e regularização de divergências contábeis;
  • Conferência e fechamento da contabilidade mensal;
  • Análise da composição das contas contábeis;
  • Apoio na elaboração de balanço patrimonial e demonstração do resultado;
  • Organização das informações para fechamento das demonstrações contábeis;

O que buscamos

Procuramos alguém que tenha:

  • Experiência em escritório de contabilidade;
  • Conhecimento das rotinas fiscais e/ou contábeis;
  • Conhecimento em empresas do Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido;
  • Boa capacidade de análise e conferência;
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos;

Por que fazer parte da Flexy?

A Flexy está vivendo um momento de crescimento e queremos trazer para a equipe pessoas que também estejam buscando evoluir profissionalmente.

Aqui, você terá contato com clientes de diferentes segmentos, poderá ampliar seus conhecimentos técnicos e participar ativamente das rotinas e do desenvolvimento do escritório.

Buscamos construir uma equipe próxima, colaborativa e comprometida com a qualidade do trabalho entregue aos nossos clientes.

Se você procura uma oportunidade para aprender, assumir responsabilidades, desenvolver sua carreira e crescer junto com um escritório que está em expansão, queremos conhecer você.

This is a standalone, high-impact role where you will act as the bridge between our local workforce and our global HR strategy, with a strong focus on operational excellence and cultural alignment.

Key Responsibilities

1. 3PL Workforce Management

  • Oversee local workforce deployment across warehouse and logistics operations (including Supervisor, Operator, and other roles); manage hiring cadence with labor vendors to ensure on-time staffing and operational continuity.

2. Labor Law & Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian labor laws, including but not limited to CLT, collective bargaining agreements, payroll regulations, and occupational health & safety requirements. Mitigate compliance risks through proactive monitoring and auditing.

3. Vendor Management & RFQ

  • Evaluate and onboard alternative labor vendors; lead RFQ benchmarking and contract negotiations. Build a multi-vendor strategy to ensure service continuity and cost efficiency.

4. Local Employee Relations

  • Handle employee relations matters including attendance, disciplinary actions, grievances, and terminations in accordance with Brazilian labor regulations. Foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture across multicultural teams.

5. HR Data & Reporting

  • Maintain and report on key HR metrics (headcount, attrition rate, hiring gaps, compliance status). Provide weekly reports to business leadership to support strategic decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of HR experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing sectors.
  • Vendor Management: Proven experience managing labor outsourcing and vendor contract negotiations.
  • Local Expertise: Deep understanding of Brazilian labor law, payroll practices, and regulatory environment.
  • Language Skills: Must be fluent in English, Mandarin, and Portuguese – you will work closely with global stakeholders and Chinese expatriate teams, as well as local Brazilian workforce.
  • Location: Based in São Paulo, with occasional travel to other Brazil sites as required.
  • Nationality: Brazilian candidates are strongly preferred.

Why Join Us

  • Global Platform – Be part of Lenovo's world-class supply chain ecosystem, operating across Brazil, China, Saudi, Mexico, and beyond.
  • Local Ownership – Take full ownership of HR operations in Brazil, with the autonomy to shape local policies and practices.
  • Multicultural Impact – Work in a dynamic, diverse environment where your work directly bridges cultures and drives operational success.
  • Competitive Rewards – We offer a competitive compensation package including medical insurance, retirement plans, performance bonuses, and more.

Our Commitment

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and proudly are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Analista de operações
description:
Sobre o IBF

O IBF (Instituto Brasileiro de Florestas) atua com silvicultura de madeiras nobres desde 2006. Com sede em Londrina/PR e operação em Minas Gerais, tornou-se referência nacional no setor.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Operações e Customer Success para organizar, acompanhar e aprimorar a operação do departamento responsável pelo relacionamento, sucesso e suporte pós-venda aos clientes.

A posição responderá diretamente à diretoria e apoiará três profissionais de Customer Success. Será responsável pela organização dos processos, operação do CRM, governança dos dados, controle de relatórios, acompanhamento dos indicadores e integração entre Customer Success, Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial e Diretoria.

A função será predominantemente de bastidor. Entretanto, poderá realizar contatos específicos com clientes para envio de relatórios, aplicação de pesquisas de satisfação, atualização cadastral, cobrança de documentos ou contratos, confirmação de recebimento e outros procedimentos pontuais.

Missão da função

Garantir que os processos, dados, ferramentas, relatórios e fluxos da jornada pós-venda estejam organizados, mensurados e executados conforme as diretrizes da diretoria, apoiando a equipe de Customer Success, identificando riscos e propondo melhorias contínuas na experiência, retenção e sucesso dos clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar e acompanhar a operação diária do departamento de Customer Success;
  • Administrar o fluxo do pós-venda no CRM e nos demais sistemas utilizados pela empresa;
  • Manter atualizados os cadastros, históricos, documentos e informações dos clientes;
  • Realizar a segmentação dos clientes conforme os critérios estabelecidos pela diretoria;
  • Organizar e acompanhar o onboarding de novos clientes;
  • Apoiar a distribuição das carteiras, demandas e atividades entre os profissionais de Customer Success;
  • Controlar registros de contatos, reuniões, solicitações, providências e retornos;
  • Identificar clientes sem acompanhamento, registros incompletos, atividades vencidas e demandas sem resolução;
  • Cobrar dos responsáveis a atualização das informações e o cumprimento dos procedimentos;
  • Acompanhar pendências operacionais, técnicas, cadastrais e contratuais;
  • Articular demandas com Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial, Jurídico e demais áreas responsáveis;
  • Apoiar os processos de renovação, retenção, indicação, upsell e cross-sell;
  • Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias na jornada pós-venda;
  • Organizar o calendário de relatórios periódicos enviados aos clientes;
  • Reunir dados e cobrar informações das áreas responsáveis;
  • Controlar responsáveis, prazos, aprovações, versões e histórico dos relatórios;
  • Redigir, revisar, adaptar e diagramar relatórios e comunicações;
  • Submeter os conteúdos técnicos à validação de Operações Florestais e da diretoria;
  • Conferir dados, documentos, anexos, links e informações antes do envio;
  • Apoiar os profissionais de Customer Success no envio e na apresentação dos relatórios;
  • Realizar eventualmente o envio direto de materiais aos clientes;
  • Realizar contatos específicos com clientes quando necessário;
  • Apoiar pesquisas de NPS, CSAT e outras avaliações de satisfação;
  • Apoiar a cobrança de contratos, aditivos e demais documentos;
  • Apoiar ações e campanhas de relacionamento, retenção e engajamento;
  • Organizar listas e segmentações de clientes para comunicações específicas;
  • Criar, manter e aprimorar o health score da carteira de clientes;
  • Classificar clientes conforme seu nível de relacionamento, engajamento e risco;
  • Identificar clientes sem contato recente, insatisfeitos, inadimplentes ou com demandas recorrentes;
  • Identificar riscos de cancelamento, reclamações e situações que exijam intervenção;
  • Auditar registros de atendimentos, reuniões, mensagens, e-mails e demais interações;
  • Verificar qualidade, clareza, completude, postura e cumprimento dos procedimentos;
  • Organizar contratos, aditivos, documentos e informações cadastrais;
  • Controlar vencimentos, reajustes, renovações e assinaturas;
  • Apoiar a interlocução com o Financeiro em situações de inadimplência;
  • Criar, atualizar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Consolidar os indicadores da jornada pós-venda;
  • Conferir a integridade, consistência e atualização dos dados;
  • Preparar relatórios semanais e periódicos para a diretoria;
  • Criar e atualizar scripts, modelos de e-mail, apresentações, pesquisas, formulários e checklists;
  • Documentar processos e manter atualizados os playbooks e manuais do departamento;
  • Apoiar a integração e o treinamento de novos profissionais de Customer Success.

Indicadores acompanhados

O profissional participará da consolidação e evolução de indicadores como:

  • Clientes ativos e carteiras por responsável;
  • Onboardings iniciados, pendentes e concluídos;
  • Tempo de conclusão do onboarding;
  • Cobertura e frequência de contato com a carteira;
  • Clientes sem acompanhamento;
  • Demandas abertas, concluídas e vencidas;
  • Backlog, tempo de primeira resposta, tempo de resolução e cumprimento dos SLAs;
  • Relatórios previstos, entregues e atrasados;
  • NPS, CSAT e demais indicadores de satisfação;
  • Reclamações, reincidências e motivos de insatisfação;
  • Health score e distribuição dos clientes por nível de risco;
  • Retenção, churn, cancelamentos, renovações e indicações;
  • Oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e receita de expansão;
  • Reembolsos, inadimplência e pendências documentais ou contratuais;
  • Qualidade e completude dos registros;
  • Aderência aos processos e produtividade da equipe.

Não é necessário que o candidato já domine todos esses indicadores. Espera-se capacidade analítica e disposição para aprendê-los progressivamente com o apoio da diretoria e da equipe.

Sistemas, inteligência artificial e automações

  • Apoiar a integração e o fluxo de informações entre os diferentes sistemas;
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial para análise, redação, revisão, classificação e consolidação de informações;
  • Criar e aprimorar prompts e assistentes para apoiar a equipe;
  • Desenvolver automações para atividades recorrentes;
  • Automatizar alertas de risco, pendências, vencimentos e prazos;
  • Garantir que o uso das ferramentas respeite as políticas de segurança e confidencialidade.

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Comunicação, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Interesse ou experiência em Customer Success, atendimento, relacionamento ou pós-venda;
  • Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de redigir e revisar relatórios e comunicações;
  • Raciocínio analítico e facilidade para trabalhar com indicadores;
  • Facilidade para organizar tarefas, prazos, documentos e diferentes responsáveis;
  • Capacidade de transformar diretrizes em processos, checklists e rotinas;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com planilhas, dashboards e sistemas de gestão;
  • Perfil responsável, proativo, criterioso e comprometido com prazos;
  • Postura profissional para lidar com informações sensíveis e clientes de alta renda;
  • Disposição para documentar processos e propor melhorias;
  • Interesse e facilidade para utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial.

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:

title: Private Wealth Advisor
description:
Company Description

Garavello Capital helps individuals and families protect what they have built and plan confidently for the future. Headquartered in the United States, the firm specializes in asset protection, retirement planning, and college planning. Advisors design tailored strategies aligned with each client's unique goals, priorities, and risk profile. The company rejects one-size-fits-all approaches, instead focusing on solutions informed by a deep understanding of client needs, timelines, and vision. Team members collaborate closely with clients to deliver long-term, holistic wealth and protection strategies.

Role Description

The Private Wealth Advisor is a full-time, remote role responsible for providing comprehensive financial guidance to individuals and families. Day-to-day activities include meeting with clients virtually, assessing financial situations, and developing personalized plans for asset protection, retirement, estate, and education funding. The advisor will analyze investment options, explain complex financial concepts in accessible terms, and monitor client portfolios to ensure alignment with changing goals and market conditions. The role involves building and maintaining long-term client relationships, preparing clear recommendations and reports, and collaborating with internal partners where needed. The advisor will also stay current on financial planning best practices and industry trends to deliver informed, ethical advice.

Qualifications

  • Strong financial planning skills, including experience in holistic Financial Planning and Retirement Planning; Certified Financial Planner (CFP) designation or progress toward it is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Investments, including portfolio construction, risk management, and long-term wealth accumulation strategies.
  • Experience in Estate Planning and asset protection, with the ability to coordinate strategies with legal and tax professionals.
  • Business Relationship Management skills, with a track record of building trust, managing client expectations, and delivering high-quality service.
  • Relevant bachelor's degree (e.g., Finance, Economics, Business) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment, with high integrity and adherence to regulatory and ethical standards.

title: Representante Técnico(a) de Vendas
description:

Na ICL, acreditamos que a inovação começa com pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Somos uma empresa global de soluções em especialidades, com presença em mais de 30 países e impacto em setores essenciais como agricultura, alimentos e materiais industriais.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.

Nossa missão:

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Como fazemos isso:

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

Nossos princípios:

  • Inovação: Criada por pessoas apaixonadas, apoiada por infraestrutura de P&D e parcerias estratégicas, formando um ecossistema único.
  • Cuidado: Fazer o que é certo para nossos colaboradores, parceiros de negócios, acionistas, comunidades e meio ambiente.

Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms
