title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we've put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We're a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance.

You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office.

As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years' relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Esta é uma função essencialmente mão na massa. Procuramos alguém que una olhar criativo, domínio técnico de edição e, principalmente, organização, agilidade e compromisso com prazos. A estratégia e a direção criativa serão conduzidas pela liderança da marca; esta posição será responsável por fazer a operação de conteúdo avançar com autonomia.

O QUE BUSCAMOS

  • Olhar para ritmo, narrativa, estética e qualidade de acabamento, especialmente em conteúdo para redes sociais.

title: Aviation Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project "Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006."

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer.

The contract will require the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific. The intended start date is January 2027, with an implementation period of 48 months.

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the aviation sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of aviation infrastructure and air transport projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting airport master planning, infrastructure development and air connectivity planning.
  • Advising on airport infrastructure, airport systems, air transport services and operational efficiency.
  • Supporting aviation safety, security and compliance with relevant international and European standards and good practices.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning for aviation infrastructure.
  • Promoting sustainable and low-carbon aviation, including measures to improve energy efficiency and reduce the environmental footprint of airport operations.
  • Integrating climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and environmental and social considerations into aviation infrastructure planning and investment.
  • Supporting policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the aviation sector.
  • Contributing to the assessment and improvement of investment climates and regulatory frameworks for aviation infrastructure and services.
  • Providing capacity building and technical assistance to civil aviation authorities, airport operators, public institutions and other sector stakeholders.
  • Coordinating with public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.
  • Supporting the promotion and adoption of European standards and good practices in partner countries.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master's degree or equivalent diploma in aeronautical engineering, airport engineering, civil engineering, transport engineering, aviation management, or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the aviation sector, including airports, air transport, aviation safety, air connectivity and sustainability aspects, as well as related policies and international good practices.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the aviation sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of aviation infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to aviation infrastructure and services delivery, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability considerations.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of aviation infrastructure, airport systems and/or air transport services.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in aviation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America or Asia.
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the aviation sector, in particular on the technical side, such as feasibility studies, project design, airport planning, aviation safety, social and environmental issues, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, operational efficiency and resilience, etc.

Assets

  • Professional experience in the Sub-Saharan Africa region (in situ).
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the aviation sector.
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: AI Tech Lead
description:
Preferred Time Zone: CT

Must-Have Skills:

Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality AI agents, skills, assistants, workflows, or integrations. Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows; skills, tools, and function calling; Model Context Protocol; prompt and context design; retrieval-augmented generation; enterprise search and data connectors; grounding, citations, memory, and context management; model and agent evaluation; and AI safety and access controls.

Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise SaaS, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms.

Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management.

Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, service accounts, delegated authorization, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.

Notes: No direct reports. This role is more leading through influence by setting standards, mentoring other admins/engineers, etc.

Strong preference in AI technology depth, with lighter platform administration experience rather than the other way around.

Scope of Work: The AI Platform Technical Lead is the hands-on technical owner of the organization's general-purpose, AI-enabled collaboration ecosystem, spanning Slack, Google Workspace with Gemini, Glean, and general-purpose AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT. Working within the strategy and priorities established by the organization, this role translates platform direction into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The Technical Lead configures, maintains, and improves these platforms based on data and feedback; builds agents and reusable skills; implements integrations; establishes technical patterns; and guides other contributors through technical expertise and example.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain AI agents, skills, prompts, tools, workflows, and automations.
  • Build AI solutions using MCP, function calling, APIs, agents, and integration frameworks.
  • Translate business needs into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready AI capabilities.
  • Build secure integrations across Slack, Google Workspace/Gemini, Glean, AI assistants, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop APIs, data connectors, webhooks, search integrations, and RAG/semantic-search solutions.
  • Ensure AI systems preserve source-system permissions, access controls, data security, and governance requirements.
  • Test and evaluate AI solutions for quality, reliability, safety, performance, and data grounding.
  • Administer and optimize enterprise AI platforms, including access, configurations, integrations, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot complex AI platform, integration, connector, and data-retrieval issues.
  • Establish standards for AI agents, integrations, configurations, testing, deployment, and security.
  • Lead technical solution reviews, mentor contributors, and serve as the senior technical escalation point.
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide technical recommendations to platform leadership.

Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.

Oferecemos

  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Analista de DHO Pleno
description:

Requisitos

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade para conduzir interações e construir relacionamento com diferentes públicos;

title: Consultor de Demanda - Neurologia
description:
Descrição do Cargo: Como Consultor de Demanda especializado em Neurologia, você desempenhará um papel estratégico na identificação e no engajamento dos HCPs-alvo e na gestão do território sob sua responsabilidade.

Sua atuação será fundamental para apoiar o propósito da Multicare de melhorar e prolongar a vida dos pacientes, por meio da construção de relacionamentos de confiança, geração de valor para os profissionais de saúde e excelência na execução da estratégia do produto.

O objetivo é impulsionar a geração de demanda de maneira ética, sustentável e orientada às necessidades dos pacientes e dos profissionais de saúde.

Formação: Superior em Administração de Empresas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou áreas correlatas.

Basico: Conhecimento sólido do sistema de saúde brasileiro, tanto público quanto privado, e do mercado farmacêutico.

Específicos: Compreensão das particularidades e desafios relacionados às doenças raras e/ou à neurologia, bem como capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Operações e demais áreas envolvidas, contribuindo para o sucesso da estratégia do produto e, principalmente, para a jornada do paciente;

Experiência: Experiência prévia no setor farmacêutico, preferencialmente em posições relacionadas à geração de demanda, promoção de produtos farmacêuticos e relacionamento com neurologistas, neurologistas pediátricos e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos na jornada do paciente.

É desejável experiência comprovada em:

  • geração de demanda;
  • planejamento e execução de visitas;
  • gestão de território e contas;
  • relacionamento e engajamento com HCPs;
  • acesso ao mercado de saúde brasileiro;
  • atuação nos sistemas público e privado de saúde;
  • produtos de alta complexidade, neurologia e/ou doenças raras.

Atribuições e Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, personalizar e executar jornadas de engajamento para HCPs-alvo, considerando suas necessidades e preferências e utilizando adequadamente os conteúdos e canais de interação disponibilizados pela companhia.
  • Construir relacionamentos profissionais sólidos e sustentáveis com HCPs e demais stakeholders estratégicos, buscando estabelecer uma colaboração de longo prazo e gerar valor para os clientes, pacientes e para a Multicare.
  • Proporcionar uma experiência de excelência e centrada no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades, seu ambiente de saúde e os desafios relacionados à jornada do paciente.
  • Utilizar de forma estratégica as fontes de dados e informações disponíveis para segmentar, priorizar e revisar continuamente o território, as contas e os planos de interação com clientes.
  • Desenvolver e executar planos de território e de contas, estabelecendo prioridades, objetivos, indicadores e ações necessárias para maximizar o potencial de cada região sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades e barreiras relacionadas ao diagnóstico, tratamento, acesso e jornada do paciente, compartilhando os insights relevantes com as áreas internas responsáveis.
  • Compartilhar continuamente percepções e insights dos clientes com os stakeholders internos pertinentes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de conteúdos, campanhas, estratégias e planos de interação relacionados ao produto e à sua indicação.
  • Trabalhar de maneira integrada com equipes multifuncionais, especialmente Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Marketing e Operações, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções que atendam às necessidades identificadas no mercado.
  • Desenvolver e manter conhecimento aprofundado sobre o produto, sua indicação, o cenário terapêutico, a jornada do paciente, o ambiente competitivo e as particularidades do território sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Contribuir para a geração de demanda de forma responsável, sustentável e ética, respeitando rigorosamente as indicações aprovadas, as políticas internas da Multicare e todas as normas regulatórias e de compliance aplicáveis.
  • Monitorar sistematicamente os resultados e indicadores de performance de seu território, identificando desvios, oportunidades e ações necessárias para o atingimento dos objetivos estabelecidos.
  • Representar a Multicare perante médicos, instituições e demais stakeholders de maneira profissional, ética e compatível com os valores e padrões de excelência da companhia.
  • Agir permanentemente com integridade, transparência e respeito no relacionamento com clientes, pacientes, colegas e parceiros.

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Buscamos profissionais ambiciosos, comprometidos e orientados a resultados, que desejem integrar um time de alta performance, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e estratégico.

Procuramos pessoas com forte capacidade de execução, maturidade profissional, senso de responsabilidade e disposição para assumir protagonismo na gestão de seu território.

Em um modelo de gestão de contas e territórios, o Consultor será responsável por liderar sua região com visão estratégica, disciplina de execução e foco em resultados, promovendo um elevado nível de engajamento com médicos e demais stakeholders.

Esperamos uma atuação pautada por excelência, ética, compliance, colaboração multidisciplinar e foco permanente no paciente, contribuindo para ampliar o acesso a terapias inovadoras em neurologia e para consolidar a Multicare como um parceiro de confiança dos profissionais e instituições de saúde.

Vaga PJ na Vila Olimpia - São Paulo

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You'll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 4+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Remote Privacy Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents.
  • Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes.
  • International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows.
  • Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR.
  • A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager

Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C (exclusive membership services), B2B (corporate travel management), and B2B2C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool.

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.

CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)

We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.
  • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.
  • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.
  • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.
  • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

  • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus

Why Join Us

  • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.
  • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.
  • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.
  • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements

bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company's evolution and stakes.

Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws).
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.

Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.

Important Note Before Applying:

Let's keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume. We're not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one.

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we're excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let's keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

bTd Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Coordenador de licenciamento
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos o Grupo ADN!

Nascemos com a missão de democratizar o acesso à habitação de qualidade, sem imaginar o quanto iríamos crescer, e quantas vidas iríamos transformar pelo caminho.

Onde o Grupo ADN chega, a gente deixa mais do que obras: incentivamos o esporte, promovemos ações sociais, buscamos sustentabilidade e realizamos sonhos. Nosso propósito vai além da construção, nós transformamos o futuro das pessoas, gerando oportunidades e mais qualidade de vida.

NOSSA ESSÊNCIA

Buscamos pessoas que estejam alinhadas com o nosso propósito de transformar vidas e realizar sonhos, e que curtam caminhar na mesma direção que a gente!

Aqui no Grupo ADN, acreditamos que bons resultados nascem de bons valores. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que:

Sejam transparentes e verdadeiras, com honestidade e clareza em todas as relações.

Trabalhem unidas e engajadas, porque aqui ninguém faz nada sozinho.

Busquem sempre a excelência, com vontade de fazer melhor todos os dias.

Tenham responsabilidade e cuidado com pessoas, processos e o ambiente ao redor.

Sejam resilientes e ousadas, prontas para inovar e superar desafios.

Criem valor em cada entrega e ajam com o foco do cliente, como se estivessem atendendo a si mesmas.

Quer fazer parte disso? Acesse nosso site de carreiras e se inscreva. Juntos, vamos construir muitas histórias!

DESAFIO DA VAGA

Coordenar os processos de licenciamento e aprovação de empreendimentos imobiliários, assegurando o cumprimento das exigências legais junto aos órgãos municipais, estaduais e federais, bem como a obtenção de alvarás e demais autorizações necessárias, garantindo eficiência, cumprimento de prazos e mitigação de riscos regulatórios.

  • Carteira de Habilitação B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação na região de Ribeirão Preto - SP.

VAI SER AINDA MAIS INCRÍVEL SE VOCÊ TAMBÉM TIVER...

• Curso ou especialização em Gestão de Negócios, Gestão de Projetos ou Incorporação Imobiliária;

SEU PAPEL NA CONSTRUÇÃO DOS NOSSOS SONHOS

  • Coordenar os processos de licenciamento e aprovação de empreendimentos, garantindo a obtenção de alvarás, licenças e demais autorizações junto aos órgãos competentes;

title: User Operations Manager
description:
About the role

This role sits at the intersection of operations, product, data, and business strategy. You'll own the full operational engine behind key consumption moments.

You'll work across Merchant Ops, Courier Ops, Product, CRM, Customer Experience, and Marketing, requiring strong cross-functional coordination and a bias for action.

Job Responsabilities

Core Initiatives Identification & Design

  • Identify, validate, and prioritize core consumption moments
  • Build a structured framework to map demand opportunities and guide development priorities
  • Develop playbooks
  • Conduct competitor analysis and benchmarks
  • Design and execute user surveys to understand pain points and behavioral drivers
  • Translate data insights into operational actions and strategic recommendations

User Operations

  • Own the full execution cycle: Ideation → kickoff → planning → 360 Coordintation→ launch → performance tracking → iteration
  • Manage and Optimizate budget
  • Coordination with Marketing, Product, CRM, and Resources teams
  • Act as a liaison between various stakeholders (Product, Marketing, Business, Data, Customer Experience, Delivery) to ensure a 360-degree view of the customer

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields
  • 5+ years of robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms
  • Background in e-commerce, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact
  • Experience with CRM platforms and communication channel management
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills, preferrably previous experience with Product and Martech
  • Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to balance user delight with business impact

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Gestor(a) de Contas & Projetos | Agência de comunicação | POA
description:
Gestor(a) de Contas & Projetos

Acreditamos que uma boa gestão de contas vai muito além de manter uma boa relação com o cliente.

É entender profundamente o negócio, o que foi vendido e o que precisa ser entregue; estruturar os próximos passos; conectar as pessoas certas; acompanhar os projetos de ponta a ponta; antecipar riscos e garantir que cliente e equipe estejam sempre alinhados.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para assumir a gestão de contas e projetos de uma carteira de clientes da Bando.

Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir a jornada do cliente dentro da agência, desde o recebimento do projeto pelo Comercial até o acompanhamento contínuo das entregas, fazendo a ponte entre cliente, estratégia, conteúdo, criação e operação.

Buscamos alguém com experiência consistente, autonomia, visão de negócio e senso de dono. Uma pessoa que saiba construir relações, mas que também tenha capacidade de estruturar projetos, organizar prioridades, gerir escopo, antecipar problemas e fazer as coisas acontecerem.

Candidaturas serão validadas mediante preenchimento do formulário:

O que você fará na prática

  • Assumir a gestão de uma carteira de clientes, sendo responsável pela condução das contas e projetos;
  • Receber o bastão do Comercial e compreender o que foi vendido, o escopo contratado, os objetivos, expectativas e principais combinados com o cliente;
  • Consolidar o contexto e histórico da conta e conduzir o onboarding, garantindo que informações, responsabilidades, prioridades e próximos passos estejam claros;
  • Transformar escopos e objetivos em planos de ação, estruturando etapas, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e próximos passos;
  • Estruturar, conduzir e acompanhar projetos de ponta a ponta, garantindo evolução e cumprimento dos combinados;
  • Conectar e mobilizar as diferentes áreas da agência em torno dos projetos, garantindo clareza sobre responsabilidades e prioridades;
  • Conduzir reuniões, alinhamentos e apresentações com clientes, garantindo clareza sobre decisões, responsabilidades e próximos passos;
  • Fazer a ponte entre cliente, operação, conteúdo, criação e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas, aprovações, ajustes e pendências, realizando os follow-ups necessários para garantir o avanço dos projetos;
  • Garantir alinhamento entre o que foi vendido, contratado e executado, identificando desvios de escopo e conduzindo os alinhamentos necessários;
  • Organizar feedbacks e demandas dos clientes, transformando informações em direcionamentos claros para as equipes;
  • Acompanhar a qualidade e o andamento das entregas antes que cheguem ao cliente, garantindo coerência com o briefing, o escopo e os objetivos da conta;
  • Monitorar a saúde das contas, considerando relacionamento, entregas, prazos, escopo, resultados, riscos e oportunidades;

title: Analista de Projetos de Incorporação Pleno
description:

Se você busca desafios e quer liderar a transformação em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, essa oportunidade é para você!

Como Analista de Projetos de Incorporação Pleno você irá ser responsável por executar a gestão de projetos em fase de pré-incorporação, mediante análise de viabilidades, acompanhamento de cronogramas e interface com áreas correlatas, a fim de conceituar e definir as premissas e parâmetros dos empreendimentos a serem desenvolvidos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que você fará por aqui:

  • Executar a conceituação e o desenvolvimento de empreendimentos imobiliários, mediante análise das premissas do produto e alinhamento com a gerência de incorporação, a fim de assegurar a aderência ao posicionamento da companhia.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas de gestão de projetos, a partir do mapeamento das etapas e marcos do empreendimento, para assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos na fase de pré-incorporação.
  • Analisar projetos e sua aderência às premissas, briefing e padrões da companhia, mediante verificação técnica e comparativa das soluções propostas, a fim de garantir a conformidade do produto com as diretrizes internas.
  • Analisar viabilidades econômicas dos empreendimentos e as definições que as impactam, com base nos parâmetros financeiros e premissas de produto, para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da gerência quanto ao desenvolvimento do projeto.
  • Realizar interface com outras áreas da companhia, mediante participação em reuniões e alinhamentos interdepartamentais, a fim de buscar o atingimento dos objetivos do empreendimento.
  • Acompanhar lançamentos no mercado e movimentações da concorrência, em interface com o time de Inteligência de Mercado, para identificar tendências e oportunidades aplicáveis aos projetos em desenvolvimento.
  • Elaborar relatórios de conclusão de projetos, mediante consolidação de dados e indicadores do empreendimento, a fim de documentar resultados e subsidiar análises futuras.
  • Pesquisar e propor diferenciais de produto, a partir de benchmarks de mercado e análise de tendências, para agregar valor aos empreendimentos em desenvolvimento.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo ou Engenharia Civil;
  • Experiência prévia em Incorporação ou Desenvolvimento de Produto;
  • Pacote office intermediário (principalmente Excel e PowerPoint);

Seria incrível se você tivesse experiência em:

  • Conhecimento prático em MS Project ou outras metodologias de gestão de cronogramas;
  • Noções em viabilidade econômica de empreendimentos imobiliários;
  • Compreensão global de todo o fluxo de incorporação imobiliária.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa que acredita que favorecer o acesso à saúde deve ser um compromisso. Aqui na Pague Menos, o cuidado está no nosso DNA. Por isso, valorizamos quem compartilha nossos valores, quem é gente que faz bem, quem tem amor por servir, quem é comprometido com o futuro do nosso negócio, quem tem senso de dono e supera resultados sempre. Afinal, fazer bem também é valorizar as pessoas, é jogar junto de um time que nos ajuda a cumprir o nosso propósito de levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros, desenvolvendo os potenciais e buscando fazer mais e melhor. Aprendendo e crescendo sempre!

Como é trabalhar aqui?

Acreditamos que pessoas diferentes constroem soluções melhores. Por isso, cultivamos um ambiente que acolhe a diversidade e incentiva cada um a ser quem é, com autenticidade e respeito. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, com espaço para aprender, propor e transformar. Mais do que executar tarefas, cada pessoa tem a oportunidade de gerar impacto real na vida de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a contagem física de produtos ou materiais em estoque, garantindo precisão e exatidão nos registros.
  • Preparar e organizar o local onde a contagem de inventário será realizada, garantindo que todos os itens estejam acessíveis e em boas condições.
  • Registrar as informações de contagem em planilhas ou sistemas de gestão de estoque, garantindo que os registros sejam atualizados de acordo com os resultados da contagem.
  • Identificar discrepâncias entre os registros de estoque e a contagem física, relatar essas discrepâncias aos supervisores e auxiliar na investigação das causas.
  • Após a contagem, reembalar ou reorganizar os produtos de acordo com as diretrizes da empresa, garantindo que tudo esteja em ordem.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com a equipe de supervisão e outros departamentos, informando sobre o progresso da contagem de inventário e quaisquer problemas encontrados.
  • Preparar relatórios de inventário, se necessário, fornecendo informações sobre os resultados da contagem e quaisquer discrepâncias identificadas.
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas relacionados ao estoque e na implementação de melhorias nos processos de inventário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

Informações adicionais

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Bônus anual;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;
  • Wellhub (plataforma de bem-estar que oferece opções de atividades físicas, mindfulness e outros);
  • Educa Mais (planos personalizados de graduação, pós-graduação, mentorias, cursos livres e de idiomas);
  • Desconto em aluguéis de carro;
  • Desconto em passagens áreas;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil, que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

title: Consultor Comercial ( Bauru-SP)
description:

Como participar deste processo (O seu desafio)

No mercado premium, a primeira impressão, a postura e a comunicação são tudo. Queremos ver a sua energia em ação, a sua capacidade de encantar e se vender.

O seu desafio: Grave um vídeo de no máximo 2 minutos (pode ser pelo celular mesmo, em um ambiente iluminado e silencioso) respondendo a duas perguntas:

  • Qual foi a sua maior conquista comercial ou negociação de alto valor que você já fechou?
  • Por que você tem o perfil certo para encantar os arquitetos e clientes premium da Studio Kitchens acelerando o resultado da empresa?

Como enviar:

  • Hospede o vídeo no YouTube (como não listado) ou no Google Drive e envie apenas o link do vídeo no corpo do e-mail.
  • Onde enviar o e-mail:
  • No assunto do e-mail: Vaga Consultor Comercial - (Seu Nome Completo)

Atenção: Profissionais de vendas de alto padrão são objetivos e focados em resultados. Candidatos que enviarem currículos em anexo sem o link do vídeo, ou vídeos com mais de 2 minutos, serão desclassificados automaticamente. Mostre o seu poder de síntese e magnetismo.

Principais Responsabilidades (O que você vai entregar)

  • Desenvolvimento e Gestão de Especificadores: Mapear, visitar e estreitar relacionamento com escritórios de arquitetura e design de interiores, transformando a Studio Kitchens na primeira opção de especificação deles.

  • Negociação e Fechamento de Alto Padrão: Conduzir negociações complexas de alto valor (tickets elevados) com inteligência emocional, elegância e foco na superação de metas.

O que você vai dominar e gerenciar (O dia a dia)

  • Universo Premium e Luxo: Dominar os diferenciais técnicos, tecnologias e o design das marcas de eletrodomésticos premium e dos nossos móveis planejados.
  • Leitura de Projetos e Tendências: Compreender layouts arquitetônicos básicos para dialogar de igual para igual com os especificadores sobre suas necessidades.
  • Gestão de Pipeline e Pós-Venda: Alimentar o CRM com precisão para acompanhar cada etapa da jornada de compra e garantir que a transição para a equipe de engenharia/montagem seja impecável.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support iQIYI's expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Overseas Pre-sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility:

Solution Development and Customization:

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development:

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.

Requirement:

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

A Forno de Minas é uma das mais tradicionais empresas do segmento de alimentos do Brasil, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e proximidade com seus consumidores.
